title: Buy Goose Down? This is what you should know about the 'filling power'
text:
If everything else is the same, an ounce of 800 filling down will keep it warmer than an ounce of 650 stuffed down, and will be compressed to a smaller size, which means that it will be easier to store it in a pocket or bag. Almost universally, the lowest, the lowest will cost more, and once you get a power of up to 800 to 1,000 filled, you will pay several hundred dollars for what you are buying, be it a technical parka outdoors, sleeping bag Winter, or cozy beddon.
What about synthetic isolation?
Synthetic substitutes down, like Primaloft Do not use filling power as measurement. That makes it harder to compare warmth between two jackets.
An approach would be to discover the weight of insulation in the garment, although manufacturers do not always reveal this information. Even if you communicate with customer service to find the filling weight, the comparison is eliminated if the type of synthetic insulation differs from a garment to the next. Primaloft Gold It is different from primaloft silver, which differs even more than 3M without feathers . There is simply not an easy metric to compare synthetic insulation, the way you can use the filling power for goose.
Synthetic isolation does not compromise as small as the goose down, and still does not match its heat. To make a synthetic jacket as warm as a falling jacket, the manufacturer has to put more isolation, making it more bulky and swollen. I buy goose exclusively when I work at temperatures below 30 degrees Fahrenheit.
